data.body: CONSUME-PATH VERIFICATION (resolves the open question): Traced merge-to-main-pr.sh:2946-3014. When _RESUME_STATE_PR_URL is set (the :2915 open-PR detection), the script skips _check_duplicate_pr (:2954) AND _phase_staged_intermediate+_phase_merge ENTIRELY (:2969-2975), jumping to final-PR polling (:3002+). That is correct only when the recorded pr_url is the FINAL promotion PR (the original b0ad-69ee resume use case). For an OPEN PR1 (source->staged, e.g. review failed), un-gating :2915 would make a bare re-run poll PR1 as terminal and never create PR2 -> incomplete promotion. CONCLUSION: the investigator's 'un-gate BOTH 2893 and 2915' is NOT safe for :2915. REVISED MINIMAL FIX (narrower than investigation proposal): un-gate ONLY :2893 (advance-to-PR2 when PR1 merged + staged exists) -> fixes the documented duplicate-PR-on-bare-reinvocation (#490/#492 scenario A). For scenario B (open PR1), keep _check_duplicate_pr's exit-1 but make its message POSITIVE (push fix to the branch; the queued auto-merge re-evaluates; re-run advances to PR2 once PR1 merges). Full iterate-on-open-PR is deferred to MQ-4 (which retires the staged-*/PR1/PR2 two-tier entirely). This narrowed scope is a revision of the investigation's proposed fix and will be opus-reviewed before implementation per project directive.
